title: Never ship before the sixth confirmation exists
scenario: Ship at depth 1, then a reorg orphans the anchor: a shipped receipt becomes permanently unverifiable. The service must return a receipt only when h*..h*+5 exist and are bundled.

mutations.detail: poll the issue API while the anchor has 1..5 confirmations

needs: Live: request a receipt and poll; any receipt returned must verify, and its pool must hold h*..h*+5 for the receipt, snapshot and git proofs. A reorg cannot be induced on mainnet; the reorg half needs a simulated chain.

staging_harness.status: requires staging harness (live half observable through the public API)
staging_harness.harness: staging issuer with the simulated chain; the harness can hold the chain at a chosen depth; API responses and the issuer outbox are logged
staging_harness.depth_convention: The model's DepthK = 5 counts successors of the including block (P5c_IssuanceProtocol.tla:202, :262; k6 cfgs DepthK = 5), so shipping needs h*..h*+5: six confirmations.
sequence: S1 submit request R; stub mines h* (1 confirmation)
S2 for c = 1..5: hold the chain at c confirmations for at least one issuer decision cycle; poll the API and read the outbox
observations: O1 at every hold c = 1..5: no receipt in any API response and none in the outbox
O2 after S3: a receipt is returned; its headers hold h*..h*+5 for the receipt, snapshot and git proofs, and it verifies VALID_STRICT
O3 (simulated reorg, optional) orphaning h* during S2 produces no receipt and a new attempt

controls.expect: the receipt ships only after the sixth confirmation (O2)

staging_harness.public_api_only: Through the public API alone only O2's bundle half is checkable: any returned receipt must hold h*..h*+5 for all three proofs. Polling cannot exclude a premature shipment.
staging_harness.test_oracle_limit: The TEST issuer refuses when h*+5's header is absent (receipt_anchored = false). That is evidence completeness, not the live sequence.

status_note: requires staging harness; not exercisable through the public API alone
